scan_checklist.description: Categories of issues to scan for when auditing any Supabase/Postgres schema. Use these as a recurring audit framework.

categories.name: Text columns that should be UUID FKs
categories.description: Find columns named *_id that are text type instead of uuid with REFERENCES constraint
categories.query: SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE column_name LIKE '%_id' AND data_type = 'text' AND table_schema = 'public'
categories.risk: No referential integrity — can store IDs pointing to non-existent rows
categories.notes: purchase_orders.supplier_id, po_versions.supplier_id, fifo_cost_layers.receival_id all fixed. Remaining: rfq_quotes.supplier_id (production only).

categories.name: JSONB columns containing line items
categories.description: Find JSONB columns that store arrays of structured objects (items, lines, allocations) — candidates for normalization into child tables
categories.query: SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE data_type = 'jsonb' AND table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name
categories.risk: Cannot enforce constraints, cannot index individual fields, cannot join efficiently
categories.notes: 7 JSONB columns normalized into tables (FIXED-004 through FIXED-013). Remaining: inventory_groups.items (ISSUE-004), payment_milestones on PO/SO/po_versions (intentional schedule data), po_line_items.fifo_layers (intentional snapshot).

categories.name: Text columns with CHECK constraints (should be enums)
categories.description: Find text columns that have CHECK constraints limiting to a fixed set of values — candidates for enum types
categories.query: SELECT tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, cc.check_clause FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc JOIN information_schema.check_constraints cc ON tc.constraint_name = cc.constraint_name WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'CHECK' AND tc.table_schema = 'public'
categories.risk: Inconsistency — some status columns use enums, others use text+CHECK. Enum gives type safety at the Postgres level
categories.notes: All invoice text+CHECK columns converted to enums: doc_status (20260715120000), payment_status (20260715120000), invoice_type and direction (20260715220000). Dependent views, indexes, and CHECK constraints handled in migration.

categories.name: Tables without RLS enabled
categories.description: Find tables that do not have row-level security enabled — security risk with Supabase anon key
categories.query: SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename NOT IN (SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND rowsecurity = true)
categories.risk: Anyone with the anon key can read/write the entire table
categories.notes: All 144 baseline tables + all new tables have RLS enabled. Verified in audit.

categories.name: Tables with RLS enabled but no policies
categories.description: Find tables that have RLS enabled but zero policies — effectively locked out for everyone including the app
categories.query: SELECT schemaname, tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND rowsecurity = true AND tablename NOT IN (SELECT tablename FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public')
categories.risk: RLS is on but no policy exists — table is inaccessible, or falls back to service_role only
categories.notes: All new normalized tables have RLS policies. No tables found with RLS but zero policies.

categories.name: Missing indexes on foreign key columns
categories.description: FK columns without indexes cause slow JOINs and slow CASCADE deletes
categories.query: Look for FK columns that have no corresponding index. Every *_id column that REFERENCES another table should have an index.
categories.risk: Slow queries on JOIN and ON DELETE CASCADE operations
categories.notes: All 13 missing FK indexes added in migration 20260715190000. Covers sale_order_lines, po_line_items, invoice_line_items, warehouse_transfer_items, receival_items, po_version_lines, return_lines, sale_delivery_lines, landed_cost_item_allocations.

categories.name: Orphan/legacy columns
categories.description: Columns that appear unused — no app code references them, or a newer replacement column exists on the same table
categories.query: Cross-reference column names against src/ codebase usage. Flag columns with zero grep hits.
categories.risk: Dead schema weight — confuses developers, wastes storage
categories.notes: sale_order_lines.item_id dropped in migration 20260715200000. Confirmed zero app code references before drop.

categories.name: Redundant parent+child patterns
categories.description: Tables that have BOTH a JSONB column AND a child line-item table for the same data
categories.query: For each table with a JSONB column, check if a corresponding *_lines or *_items table exists with overlapping fields
categories.risk: Data duplication — writes must update both, reads may return stale data from one
categories.notes: All 7 redundant JSONB+table pairs resolved. JSONB columns dropped, data migrated to normalized tables.

categories.name: Nullable FKs that should be NOT NULL
categories.description: Foreign key columns that are nullable but logically should always have a value (e.g., every line item should have a parent)
categories.query: SELECT table_name, column_name, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE column_name LIKE '%_id' AND is_nullable = 'YES' AND table_schema = 'public'
categories.risk: Orphaned rows — line items without a parent, movements without a warehouse
categories.notes: Some nullable FKs are intentional (e.g., receival_items.po_line_item_id is nullable for manual receivals). Needs per-column evaluation.

categories.name: Missing ON DELETE behavior on FKs
categories.description: Foreign keys without explicit ON DELETE (defaults to NO ACTION) — can cause failed deletes or orphaned data
categories.query: SELECT tc.table_name, kcu.column_name, rc.delete_rule FROM information_schema.referential_constraints rc JOIN information_schema.table_constraints tc ON rc.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name WHERE tc.table_schema = 'public' AND rc.delete_rule = 'NO ACTION'
categories.risk: Deleting a parent row fails silently or leaves orphaned children depending on usage
categories.notes: New line-item tables all use ON DELETE CASCADE. Parent FKs (supplier_id, receival_id) intentionally use NO ACTION — you shouldn't delete a supplier or receival that has dependent records.

categories.name: Inconsistent naming conventions
categories.description: Tables/columns that don't follow the project's naming pattern (snake_case, consistent FK naming, consistent _id suffix)
categories.query: Manual review of column names for inconsistencies: e.g., some use created_by (uuid FK to profiles), others use created_by_name (denormalized text)
categories.risk: Developer confusion, incorrect assumptions about data relationships

categories.name: Denormalized name columns without FK
categories.description: Columns like supplier_name, warehouse_name, customer_name that store a copy of the name instead of (or alongside) a FK
categories.query: SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE column_name LIKE '%_name' AND table_schema = 'public' AND column_name NOT IN ('item_name', 'name')
categories.risk: Stale data — if the source entity's name changes, copies become outdated
categories.notes: Denormalized name columns are intentional in this project for audit trail and display performance. Examples: po_versions.supplier_name, warehouse_transfers.created_by_name, sale_deliveries.warehouse_name.

categories.name: Views without SECURITY INVOKER
categories.description: Views that don't use security_invoker = true run as the view creator, bypassing the caller's RLS policies
categories.query: Check all CREATE VIEW / CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW statements for WITH (security_invoker = true)
categories.risk: RLS bypass — the view runs with the owner's permissions, not the calling user's
categories.notes: All active views have security_invoker = true. warehouse_stock_view was the last one fixed (20260713170000). customer_credit_summary fixed in 20260713165620. Compat views were dropped.

categories.name: RPCs referencing dropped columns
categories.description: Stored functions that SELECT, INSERT, or UPDATE columns that no longer exist after schema changes
categories.query: Cross-reference all CREATE FUNCTION bodies against dropped columns from normalization migrations
categories.risk: Runtime errors — RPC call will fail with 'column does not exist'
categories.notes: All RPCs updated. create_and_confirm_delivery was the last one — fixed in 20260715180000 to use sale_delivery_lines instead of dropped sale_deliveries.items column. Other 8 RPCs were fixed in 20260715170000.

categories.name: Triggers on tables that were renamed or dropped
categories.description: Triggers that reference old table names after renames (e.g., divisions -> company_divisions)
categories.query: SELECT trigger_name, event_object_table FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema = 'public'
categories.risk: Trigger silently stops firing if the table was renamed and the trigger wasn't updated
categories.notes: Tables renamed: divisions→company_divisions, user_divisions→user_company_divisions, plus 5 approval tables. Need to verify no triggers reference old names.

categories.name: Missing FK constraints on line-item brand_variant_id columns
categories.description: Normalized line-item tables that store brand_variant_id as a plain uuid without a REFERENCES constraint to inventory_brand_variants
categories.query: Check return_lines, sale_delivery_lines, landed_cost_item_allocations for FK constraints on brand_variant_id
categories.risk: Can store brand_variant_id values that don't match any existing inventory_brand_variants row — no referential integrity
categories.notes: All three FK constraints added in migration 20260715200000: return_lines, sale_delivery_lines, landed_cost_item_allocations all now have FK to inventory_brand_variants(id).

categories.name: Composite key tables without PK or UNIQUE constraints
categories.description: Tables using composite natural keys (e.g., warehouse_id + brand_variant_id) without a PRIMARY KEY or UNIQUE constraint
categories.query: SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename NOT IN (SELECT tablename FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND indexdef LIKE '%PRIMARY KEY%')
categories.risk: Duplicate rows possible, no guaranteed uniqueness
categories.notes: warehouse_stock_allocations already had a PK. FK constraints added in 20260715200000. ISSUE-030 partially resolved.

categories.name: App code referencing dropped/renamed table or column names
categories.description: TypeScript hooks, components, or API routes that use old table names (divisions, approval_chains) or dropped column names (returns.items, sale_deliveries.items)
categories.risk: Runtime query errors — Supabase returns 404 for unknown tables or columns
categories.notes: All stale app code refs fixed: (1) useSaleOrders.ts SaleDelivery type renamed items→sale_delivery_lines (FIXED-021), (2) SoDetailDialog.tsx del.items→del.sale_delivery_lines (FIXED-021), (3) sales/returns/page.tsx SaleReturn['items']→NonNullable<SaleReturn['return_lines']> (FIXED-022), (4) WhMovementRefDialog.tsx non-existent columns replaced with actual schema (FIXED-023).
